notes: IB lines now show correctly on overnight charts when Extend To Session End is off.
changelog: On overnight sessions such as CME 17:00 to 16:00, calendar-anchored IBs with Extend To Session End off now draw on every past day. Before, their lines were invisible and zones stopped at the end of the IB.
This includes IBs that end at or after midnight, such as the default Block 4 at 23:00.
On the live chart, the previous day's IB keeps following price after midnight until its session closes.
